item.title: How to Build a Comprehensive Government Website for the Sikkim Local Fund Audit Directorate (SLFA)
item.description:
How to Build a Comprehensive Government Website for the Sikkim Local Fund Audit Directorate (SLFA)

A modern government website is more than an online brochure. It is a platform for transparency, accountability, public communication, and citizen services.

For the Sikkim Local Fund Audit (SLFA), the website should serve as the official source of information relating to local fund audits, audit reports, statutory provisions, annual reports, RTI disclosures, circulars, publications, and citizen services.

item.title: RTI Online Portal Training at NIC Sikkim: Complete Guide for SPIOs, ASPIOs and Nodal Officers
item.description:
RTI Online Portal Training at NIC Sikkim

On 25 June 2025, officials from various government departments attended a training programme conducted by the National Informatics Centre (NIC), Sikkim on the implementation and use of the RTI Online Portal.

The session focused on the complete lifecycle of an RTI application, user roles, workflow management, role assignment, and the responsibilities of various officers under the Right to Information Act.

This article summarizes the training and serves as a reference guide for future users of the RTI Online Portal.

item.title: Comprehensive Guide to RTI Proactive Disclosure and Internal Audit Functions in Sikkim
item.description:
Comprehensive Guide to RTI Proactive Disclosure and Internal Audit Functions in Sikkim

Transparency and accountability are the bedrock of effective financial management in government. Under Section 4(1)(b) of the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005, public authorities are mandated to proactively disclose key information regarding their organization, functions, duties, and operational procedures. This proactive disclosure minimizes the necessity for individual citizens to file formal requests while fostering public trust.

This article details the institutional framework, RTI proactive disclosures, and core objectives of both the Sikkim Local Fund Audit (SLFA) and the Internal Audit (IA) Division under the Finance Department, Government of Sikkim.
